title: Private Celebration Hike in the Rockies
includes: Transportation from meeting point to and from trail
Guide expertise to include help with hike selection, education about plants & wildlife in the area.
Guide can stop at local eatery for your group to buy lunch.
Photography-guide will capture your event with multiple photos!
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Celebrate your special moments with us in the beauty of Colorado’s outdoors! Birthdays, anniversaries, bachelor/bachelorette parties, entertaining wedding guests—whatever you’re marking, we craft a personalized hiking experience that reflects you. 

Traveling for work? Let us take you from the conference room to the mountains for a refreshing, scenic break with colleagues.

Whatever brings you here, we’ll make it unforgettable!

We are one of the longest running guiding companies of its kind; travelers have requested an experience like this. We have listened and are ready to host you and your special people for a one of a kind celebration.
